summary: Executor Zygand sends Forsaken fighters against the Scarlet Crusade near Balnir Farmstead. Their strike targets Captain Vachon and his friars in southeastern Tirisfal Glades, where Crusader raids threaten the Dark Lady's lands.

sections.title: A Looming Encroachment
sections.body: The Forsaken guard Brill and the Undercity while the Scarlet Crusade holds fortified sites across the countryside. Executor Arren reports active Crusader incursions from a crumbling guard tower in southeastern Tirisfal Glades. The tower stands close to the abandoned Balnir Farmstead.

sections.title: Severing the Chain of Command
sections.body: Executor Zygand targets the Crusade's field leaders, knowing coordinated squads pose a greater danger than scattered zealots. You strike at Captain Vachon and the Scarlet Friars who strengthen his men with holy magic. Without their leadership and support, the cell may lose its cohesion and its raids into Forsaken lands may falter.

faq.answer: Executor Zygand, stationed in Brill, orders the strike. Executor Arren gathered and delivered the frontline reports on Crusade movements near Balnir Farmstead.
Captain Vachon and his Scarlet Friars are based in a ruined watchtower in southeastern Tirisfal Glades, just east of Balnir Farmstead.

faq.q: Why does Executor Zygand target Scarlet Friars specifically?
faq.answer: Scarlet Friars give the zealots magical and spiritual support. Defeating these spellcasters takes away defensive wards and healing, crippling the squad's field operations.

faq.q: What threat does the ruined tower pose to Brill?
faq.answer: The ruined tower gives the Scarlet Crusade high ground and a fortified place to launch attacks. Its patrols can ambush Forsaken travelers and disrupt supply roads running east from Brill.

faq.q: How does this fit into the broader conflict with the Crusade?
aliases: war with the scarlet crusade lore
faq.answer: This strike is the third phase of Executor Zygand's campaign against Scarlet Crusade strongholds in Tirisfal Glades. He aims to drive the zealots back before they can lay siege to the Undercity.

faq.q: What happens after Captain Vachon is slain?
faq.answer: Captain Vachon's defeat slows Crusader advances in southeastern Tirisfal. Executor Zygand then turns his attention to larger Scarlet Crusade fortifications elsewhere in the region.

angles.text: As an Undead, you help secure your newborn nation's borders with every Crusader post cleared in Tirisfal Glades. You protect Lady Sylvanas's realm from living purifiers.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep the approach to the Undercity open and communication routes through northern Lordaeron secure.
As a Priest, you face Scarlet Friars whose dogmatic faith in holy power clashes with your mastery of the Shadow and distorted Holy power.
